verdict.rationale: Prompt or prefix caching is a fair question for an LLM inference cloud, but nothing in the evidence pack documents caching of repeated context, discounted cached tokens, or cache-hit latency gains. The pack covers only adjacent features: a priority tier for faster time-to-first-token, a flex tier for lower cost, and resending the full message history on every request. None of these is caching.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
